name: Compose and rewrite religious biblical and Quranic commentaries
description: Users primarily asked for the creation, rewriting, or formatting of commentaries, homilies, and texts focused on biblical or Quranic verses, often with specific requests to incorporate skeptical arguments or refute particular authors. This group also included requests to paraphrase religious concepts into distinct styles, such as psalms or modern language, or to generate detailed theological analyses based on provided linguistic and historical data.
